name: Reverse cash and carry
hypothesis: Short cash and buy matched futures after borrow and recall checks.
data: synchronized executable depth on every leg
spec: Setup: A future is cheap to cash and the cash leg can actually be borrowed. Entry: Short cash and buy matched futures after borrow and recall checks. Exit: Exit on convergence or borrow recall, financing change or stop. Parameters to pre-register: borrow_cost, recall_assumption, expiry, basis_buffer.
blocked_reason: needs prefunded inventory on several venues and synchronized multi-leg execution
